heading: INT. SYNERGEX CORP - OFFICE OF THE VICE PRESIDENT OF CULTURE - DAY

units.text: INT. SYNERGEX CORP - OFFICE OF THE VICE PRESIDENT OF CULTURE - DAY
A glass-walled corner office that looks onto a parking structure.
A yoga ball sits where a chair should.
A neon sign on the wall reads "BE THE CHANGE (PENDING APPROVAL)."
A whiteboard is covered with arrows that lead nowhere.
Sunlight is filtered through a fake ficus.
VICE PRESIDENT BARRETT QUIGLEY-STONE, 40s, sleeves rolled, wireless headset on one ear, bounces gently on the yoga ball.
His hair is gelled into a decision.
Across the desk sits PRUDENCE OKONJO, 30s, a quality analyst, pressed blazer, notebook on her knee, patience worn thin.
In front of her is a paper cup of kombucha she has not touched.
Prudence. Thanks for jumping on this.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: You asked me to come at nine. It's nine-forty.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Time is a social construct. But I hear you. Let's circle back to your feedback.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: It's not feedback. It's a defect report. The product ships with a battery that overheats.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: We prefer "enthusiastic."
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: It caught fire in testing.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Enthusiastic. Let's workshop that.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Barrett stands, bounces once on the ball, and caps a marker.
He writes ENTHUSIASM on the whiteboard and draws an arrow to a drawing of a flame.
Prudence watches without blinking.
Barrett, I filed this report six weeks ago.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: And we love that. Proactive. Self-starter. That's the energy.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: It's still unanswered.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Which is why I brought you here. I want to empower you to own the narrative.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: I don't want to own the narrative. I want to stop the shipment.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Shipment is a strong word.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Forty thousand units are in a warehouse in Ohio. Trucks leave Friday.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Let's not boil the ocean.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Prudence puts the notebook on the desk.
She picks up the kombucha and sets it down again, harder than she meant to.
Liquid slops over the rim.
Do you know what a thermal runaway is?
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Sounds like a marathon.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: It's when a battery cell heats the next one and the next. It doesn't stop. It's a chain reaction in someone's pocket.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: And that's why we're building a culture of openness.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: You're not hearing me.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: I'm hearing the concern. I'm holding space for it.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Prudence stands.
Her chair rolls backward and hits the ficus.
A leaf falls off.
It is plastic.
People will get burned.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Prudence. Breathe.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Don't tell me to breathe.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: We have a mindfulness app. It's free for staff.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Prudence takes the marker out of his hand.
She crosses out ENTHUSIASM and writes FIRE in letters a foot tall.
The marker squeaks.
Barrett's smile flickers, then holds.
That's not on brand.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Neither is a lawsuit.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Now you're being negative.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: I'm being accurate.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: Barrett slides off the yoga ball.
It rolls away and bumps a wall.
He picks up his headset, taps it.
Hey, Dale. Quick favor, can you hold the trucks?
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: He listens.
His face drops.
What do you mean, they left Tuesday?
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: Prudence stares at him.
Barrett slowly removes the headset and places it on the desk like a dead bird.
Tuesday.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: There may have been a miscommunication.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: You called me in here to talk me out of it. The trucks were already gone.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: I was going to loop you in.
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: You were going to loop me out.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: She picks up her notebook.
Barrett stands very still.
The neon sign hums.
Prudence flips to a fresh page, writes something, tears it out, and sets it on his desk.
What is this?
units.name: BARRETT

units.text: My resignation. And the number for the fire marshal.
units.name: PRUDENCE

units.text: She walks out.
The door swings behind her.
Barrett stares at the page.
He sits on the floor where the yoga ball used to be, and the neon sign flickers off.
